item.title: Judge Rejects Trump’s EPA Claim, NAACP Sues Space XAI
item.description: Judge rejects Trump’s bid to let EPA dismiss NAACP’s lawsuit against Elon Musk’s Space XAI over unpermitted turbines at Memphis’s Colossus data center.
